payload.summary: Differentials presentation comparison claims 4 of 7 columns while rendering 7 and hiding two EMERGENCY rows
payload.detail: On /differentials/presentations/acute-confusion-encephalopathy the banner reads '4 of 7 diagnoses compared' and the rail '+3 not selected', but all seven columns render identically styled. .polished-scroll measures scrollWidth 1344 vs clientWidth 902 at 1440 - 442px hidden with no scrollbar, edge fade or cue - concealing the Must-not-miss cells for Wernicke encephalopathy and hepatic encephalopathy, both tagged EMERGENCY, on the presentation where Wernicke is the classic miss. Secondary: the sticky CRITERIA column is transparent, so scrolled text bleeds through the red-flag row labels.
